analysis.title: Anritsu (6754.T): Keysight 4Q read-across: Optical tech evolution (CPO) and 6G opportunities likely to coincide; Buy
key_insights: Keysight's FY26 4Q Commercial Communications sales (data center and mobile test equipment) were US$1,145 mn against Bloomberg consensus of US$1,052 mn, up 73% yoy.
Keysight's full-year AI-related orders grew about 2.5X yoy. Management saw no negative change in order patterns or pipelines after the US presidential election.
Keysight expects the biggest inflection point for the transition to CPO/NPO in 2028, with 2027 a year of gradual progress.

Keysight's 6G-related business doubled yoy. With the 3GPP schedule finalized (Release 21 scheduled for 2029), the industry is moving from research to development ahead of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

Keysight cited 6G demand drivers: terrestrial and non-terrestrial network (NTN) interconnection, AI in RAN infrastructure, more complex Over-The-Air (OTA) testing, integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), and edge AI support in wireless devices.

Anritsu has said 1.6T CPO contributions could begin from mid-2027 and 6G contributions from late 2027. GS believes Keysight's commentary supports its view that optical-related and 6G demand will begin to overlap.
In optical, the transition to 1.6T is progressing gradually and R&D for 3.2T is picking up.
Keysight's customer base widened from hyperscalers to semiconductor design, interconnect, switch, transceiver and module makers, and the number of customers nearly doubled yoy.
GS rates Anritsu Buy with a 12-month target of ¥4,700, which is 101.6% above the ¥2,331 close on 19 Nov 2026. The target uses 14X EV/EBITDA on FY3/28E.

market_movers.rationale: Anritsu has no US listing. GS reiterates Buy and a ¥4,700 target (14X FY3/28E EV/EBITDA), citing Keysight's 4Q read-across for optical (CPO) and 6G demand overlap.

earnings_insights: Keysight FY26 4Q (reported 20 Nov 2026 JST), non-GAAP: company-wide sales US$1,994 mn reported vs Bloomberg consensus US$1,946 mn, organic +36% yoy.
Keysight FY26 4Q non-GAAP operating profit US$714 mn reported vs consensus US$671 mn, operating margin 35.8% (+950 bps yoy).
Keysight FY26 4Q orders US$2,339 mn reported vs consensus US$2,190 mn, organic +49% yoy.
Keysight FY26 4Q sales by region, reported: Americas US$792 mn (+29% yoy), Europe US$314 mn (+17% yoy), Asia Pacific US$888 mn (+51% yoy).

Keysight FY26 4Q Commercial Communications sales, reported: US$1,145 mn vs Bloomberg consensus US$1,052 mn, +73% yoy. Wireline (data center) sales grew triple digits yoy, Wireless sales grew double digits yoy.

GS estimates for Anritsu (FY3/27E, forecast): revenue ¥146.4 bn, operating profit ¥23.9 bn, EPS ¥144.5. FY3/28E: revenue ¥163.4 bn, operating profit ¥30.5 bn, EPS ¥186.0. Quarterly EPS: 6/26 ¥25.7 and 9/26 ¥25.5 (actual), 12/26E ¥44.3 and 3/27E ¥47.8 (forecast).
risk_factors: Anritsu Test and Measurement: 5G demand has already cooled, so sales may not grow as expected and margins could deteriorate.
US tariffs could slow customer decisions and leave data center demand flat or weaker.
Testing methods may shift from 100% testing to sampling testing.
PQA: possible loss of domestic market share, or sales expansion falling short in North America, Europe and China.
Environmental Measurement: battery test equipment earnings may miss if the BEV market slows.
Company-wide: disappointing returns from M&A or growth investment, a higher R&D expense ratio, and yen appreciation.
geopolitical: US tariff uncertainty could slow customer decision-making in Anritsu's data center business.
The US presidential election did not change Keysight's AI-related order patterns, according to management.
